title: Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.31090v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient vehicle routing is critical to logistics and transportation, yet solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) remains computationally challenging due to their combinatorial complexity. One approach to solve large-scale vehicle routing optimization is to identify promising subproblems and then optimize them using solvers. In this paper, we propose a framework of automatic heuristic design (AHD) in which a large language model (LLM) autonomously refines heuristics for selecting subproblems, enabling effective optimization of large-scale CVRP instances. Compared to prior approaches that train task-specific neural networks to select among heuristically constructed subproblems, our method discovers generalizable, interpretable LLM-generated heuristics to directly construct subproblems. translated_title: 重新审视学习委托：大语言模型发现的大规模车辆路径规划启发式方法
translated_abstract: 高效的车辆路径规划对物流与运输至关重要，然而由于其组合复杂性，求解大规模带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）在计算上仍然极具挑战性。解决大规模车辆路径优化的一种方法是识别有前景的子问题，然后使用求解器对其进行优化。本文提出了一种自动启发式设计（AHD）框架，其中大语言模型（LLM）自主优化用于选择子问题的启发式方法，从而实现对大规模CVRP实例的有效优化。与先前训练特定任务神经网络来在启发式构建的子问题中进行选择的方法相比，我们的方法能够发现可泛化、可解释的LLM生成启发式方法来直接构建子问题。实验表明，我们的方法在分布内性能相当的同时，优于基于神经网络的策略。
tldr: 本文提出自动启发式设计框架，利用大语言模型自主演化出可泛化、可解释的启发式方法来直接构建子问题，从而有效求解大规模带容量约束的车辆路径问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an automatic heuristic design framework where an LLM autonomously discovers generalizable, interpretable heuristics to directly construct subproblems, enabling effective optimization of large-scale CVRP instances.
